# The Corner Database

> Discover movies and TV series, explore actor details, and watch trailers.

The Corner Database is an entertainment discovery application. It uses TMDb data to help visitors browse movies and television series, view cast and actor information, and find trailers.

## Public entry point

- [Home](https://sprint7-movie-app.vercel.app/): Overview of the movie and TV discovery app.

## Access

An account is required to use the catalog, search, and detail pages. Movie and television metadata is provided by TMDb.
